title: Contract Software Engineer - WebCompat Tooling (Dashboards and Reporting), Firefox
announcement: The role You will build and improve the WebCompat team’s internal tooling, the dashboards and the broken-site-report screenshot pipeline the team relies on to triage and prioritize site breakage. This is a focused tooling role that makes the WebCompat program faster and more data-driven. Responsibilities Build and improve WebCompat dashboards (triage, reporting, and metrics). Improve the broken-site-report screenshot capture and pipeline. Work with the WebCompat team (including QA) to turn reporting and triage needs into reliable tooling. Required qualifications Solid web development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python & Django) and experience building dashboards / data views. Comfort with tooling, automation, and web services. Self-directed, with good written communication. Preferred Familiarity with WebCompat workflows and Bugzilla. Experience with screenshot / automation pipelines.
